facts.label: Panquecas no fim de semana
facts.sub: Panquecas grossas são um café da manhã clássico nos EUA. Muitas famílias fazem uma pilha no sábado ou domingo e servem com manteiga, frutas e xarope de bordo, direto à mesa.

facts.label: Xarope de bordo
facts.sub: O xarope de bordo vem da seiva de uma árvore, e é a cobertura tradicional das panquecas. Ele é doce e dourado, e vem em garrafinhas que ficam sempre na mesa do café.

pages.title: The first pancake · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in Nashville, and Tom wants to make pancakes for his friend Mia. The kitchen smells like coffee, and the table already has a blue plate and two cups. Mia opens the cupboard and finds a metal spatula next to a stack of old bowls. Tom puts flour, milk and one egg on the counter. The big pan is on the stove, and it is getting warm. Mia is a little nervous because she does not cook very often.
“Good morning! Let’s make pancakes.” says Tom. “Great! Where is the spatula?” says Mia. “It’s in the cupboard, next to the stove.” says Tom.

pages.title: The first pancake · 3/3
paragraphs: “I’m waiting for bubbles. Then I’m going to flip it.” says Mia. “Perfect! Breakfast is almost ready.” says Tom. She cracks the egg, and Tom shows her how to mix the flour and milk with a whisk. Soon the batter is smooth and yellow, and it is ready for the hot pan. Tom pours a small circle, and they both watch the bubbles. When the edges look dry, Mia uses the spatula to flip the first pancake. It lands in the pan with a happy sound, and the top is golden brown. They put three pancakes on the plate and carry it to the table with butter and syrup.
